capabilities: Render Markdown into a themed live preview with synchronized scrolling and light/dark modes
Copy beautified rich text for pasting into WeChat and other platforms
Export notes as standalone HTML or PDF (image and vector modes)
Batch upload local images to cloud storage providers
Customize themes with a built-in CSS editor and Mermaid theme adaptation
disambiguation: Not a Markdown linter or source formatter; it styles the rendered output for pasting to external platforms, not the note's Markdown text.
extras: Includes a Clipboard API usage disclosure (write-only, user-triggered copy; paste handling only when auto-upload is enabled). Release assets are built with artifact attestations. Also installable via BRAT. Donations (GitHub Sponsors, WeChat Pay, Alipay) requested.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to produce styled rich text that survives WeChat's CSS restrictions when pasting notes to external platforms.

relations.evidence: It is the Obsidian integration of MD Beautify

requires.name: Cloud storage account (Qiniu, Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, S3, etc.)

summary: Markdown beautifier that converts notes into themed rich text styled for pasting into WeChat and other rich-text platforms.
